title: Digital Manual Business Analyst
description:
Dedicated to sustainable development, Arup is a collective of designers, consultants and experts working globally.

At Arup you will have the opportunity to collaborate on ambitious projects - delivering remarkable outcomes for clients and communities, and to do socially useful work that has meaning.
Arup's purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set it apart for over 75 years, and now is your opportunity to join.

AMS is a global workforce solutions partner committed to creating inclusive, dynamic, and future-ready workplaces. We help organisations adapt, grow, and thrive in an ever-evolving world by building, shaping, and optimising diverse talent strategies.
We partner with Arup to support their contingent recruitment processes. Acting as an extension of their recruitment teams, we connect them with skilled interim and temporary professionals, fostering workplaces where everyone can contribute and succeed.
On Behalf of Arup, we are looking for a Digital Manual Business Analyst for a 12-month contract based in London hybrid working 3 days per week on site.

Purpose of the role:

As a Digital Manual Business Analyst, you will support the development of clear, user-focused digital guidance by translating complex policies, standards and processes into practical, accessible content. Working closely with stakeholders and end users, you will gather requirements, analyse business needs and help shape content that improves usability and adoption. You will also contribute to the use of AI and automation tools to support content creation and maintenance, ensuring all outputs meet quality, governance and user experience standards.

What you'll do:

  • Gather and analyse business requirements to support the development and continuous improvement of the Digital Manual.
  • Conduct user research and stakeholder engagement to understand user needs, pain points and opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritised content and process recommendations.
  • Review, analyse and simplify complex policies, standards and ways of working into user-focused guidance.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts to identify content gaps, resolve inconsistencies and ensure accuracy of information.
  • Support the design and structure of Digital Manual content to improve usability, accessibility and user experience.
  • Facilitate workshops, requirements gathering sessions and stakeholder discussions to drive alignment and decision-making.
  • Use data, user feedback and insights to recommend enhancements and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Leverage AI and automation tools to support analysis, content development and process optimisation while maintaining appropriate governance and quality standards.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet business objectives, user needs and organisational standards.

The skills you'll need:

  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst within digital, content, process improvement or transformation projects.
  • Strong requirements gathering, stakeholder management and business analysis skills.
  • Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria and business requirements documentation.
  • Ability to analyse complex information and translate it into clear, user-focused solutions.
  • Experience facilitating workshops and engaging with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and digital product environments.
  • Experience with knowledge management, content improvement or digital guidance platforms is desirable.
  • Exposure to AI and automation tools would be advantageous.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
